policy: APP-TEST-OCR-INSTALLED-PILOT (desktop Stage-4 installed readonly pilot) applies only where desktopStage4Pilot is REQUIRED. NOT_APPLICABLE is distinct from PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED and must not be counted as PASS. Mobile release gates use FAMILY-N78-MOBILE-NATIVE-UI-AUTOMATION (instrumented / XCUITest) — not desktop OCR-first §3g.

statusDefinitions.REQUIRED: Desktop Stage-4 pilot overall PASS evidence required for family desktop OCR closure.
statusDefinitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Requirement must not apply; absence of PASS is not a failure for that requirement.
statusDefinitions.PASS: Executed report with overall PASS (evidence path required).
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Pilot could not complete (distinct from NOT APPLICABLE).
statusDefinitions.PLANNED: Documented future native mobile automation adoption when mobile ship lane matures.
statusDefinitions.OPTIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC: Engineering-only OCR diagnostic (Phase 4A); must never be REQUIRED for mobile release gates.

desktopOcrPolicy: Unchanged Phase 2c/4B: native-resolution screenshots, N78OcrResult v1, word boxes, verified bbox interaction, post-interaction OCR, fail-closed missing/ambiguous targets, Stage-4 evidence where REQUIRED.
mobileNativeUiAutomationPolicy: Android: instrumented tests, UI Automator, Espresso/Compose UI Test, accessibility selectors, state verification after each interaction, screenshots/logs/JUnit evidence. iOS: XCUITest, accessibility ids/labels, xcresult retention. See NIVO78_MOBILE_NATIVE_UI_AUTOMATION_STANDARD.md.
mobileOptionalOcrDiagnosticPolicy: Phase 4A N78-Ops androidTest OCR adapter is optional diagnostic only — ML Kit / OCR bbox tapping must not be listed as REQUIRED in product gates.

displayScalingValidation.note: S4D-SCALE-150 and S4D-SCALE-200 are optional read-only scope items in Stage-4; BLOCKED on pilot report is not PASS and remains outstanding until executed at that scale.

mobileBuilds.android: module present; not primary ship target

applications.rationale: N78-Ops ships on Google Play as a mobile product. Desktop Stage-4 installed OCR pilot is out of scope; mobile gates use native Android/iOS automation.

outOfScopeDesktopLaunchAttempts.description: 216x159 dialog Failed to launch JVM — exploratory/out-of-scope desktop launch; not APP-TEST-OCR-INSTALLED-PILOT failure for N78-Ops

deprecatedFields.mobileInstalledOcrPilot: Replaced schemaVersion 2 by mobileNativeUiAutomation (mandatory) and mobileOptionalOcrDiagnostic (optional). Do not require mobileInstalledOcrPilot for gates.
